purpose: Characterize BWH/FAW-style strategic surfaces against the current inactive delayed-PPLNS candidate without selecting or activating pool economics.

exact_candidate_semantics.payout_binding: weights -> payout outputs -> payoutCommitment/coinbase_root -> templateCommitment are fixed before a worker searches the returned candidate
exact_candidate_semantics.share_admission: coordinator recomputes candidate hash, verifies share target, rejects duplicate/stale jobs, then appends the share
exact_candidate_semantics.full_block_submission: when a submitted share also meets block difficulty, coordinator submits the already committed candidate and clears jobs
exact_candidate_semantics.direct_pow_fallback: protocol documentation requires direct mining to remain valid and independent of pool coordinator honesty
exact_candidate_semantics.activation: PPLNS_COINBASE_ACTIVATION_HEIGHT remains null; candidate is inactive

defensive_properties: Coordinator cannot redirect a solved candidate after PoW because payout outputs are committed before mining.
Coordinator does not need miner payout private keys.
Share ledger is durable, duplicate-resistant and hash chained.
Coordinator rejects a submitted share after the upstream chain tip changes.
Pool use is optional; direct sovereign mining remains the required fallback.

unavoidable_or_open_surfaces.rationale: A permissionless coordinator cannot distinguish a worker that never found a full-difficulty block from a worker that found one and deliberately withheld it. Submitted lower-difficulty shares can therefore coexist with withheld full blocks.
unavoidable_or_open_surfaces.security_scope: pool revenue/liveness and miner incentives; not direct consensus invalidity

unavoidable_or_open_surfaces.rationale: A withheld full candidate can in principle be used strategically around a competing block race. Coordinator stale-tip checks narrow the coordinator-mediated window, but final feasibility/profitability depends on production submission paths, propagation, fork-choice tie policy and frozen PPLNS semantics.
unavoidable_or_open_surfaces.security_scope: strategic fork creation / pool reward manipulation

unavoidable_or_open_surfaces.rationale: Do not expand into multi-pool interaction until the final pool architecture preserves multiple independent coordinator targets and final timing/economic semantics are frozen.

quantitative_evidence.caveat: Long-window proportional payout approximation; not an exact final FAE profitability claim.

candidate_characterization: coordinator payout and share integrity controls bound
final_mainnet_pool_green_requires: exact frozen PPLNS window/share target/stale-job semantics
frozen fork-choice tie policy and propagation assumptions
exact FAE pool simulation including opportunity costs
BWH/FAW profitability/risk threshold either accepted and bounded or mitigated
pool remains optional and cannot become consensus authority
